content.user_title: Draft Influencer Contracts With Clear Terms
content.value_statement: Influencer deals often stall because contract terms are vague or one-sided. This skill helps draft, review, and negotiate creator agreements with clear clauses and review checklists.
actual_capabilities: Collects parties, deliverables, compensation, platforms, usage rights, exclusivity, approvals, and disclosure details.
Drafts an 11-section influencer partnership agreement template.
Reviews incoming terms and flags missing essentials or unfair clauses.
Explains key clauses, including deliverables, compensation, usage rights, exclusivity, approvals, and morality.
Creates negotiation ranges for usage rights, exclusivity, revisions, payment, and whitelisting.
Adds FTC disclosure and platform compliance reminders.
limitations: Does not provide legal advice or replace attorney review.
Requires the user to provide deal facts and pasted contract terms.
Does not negotiate outreach before a deal exists.
Does not connect to CRM, e-signature, or creator databases unless the host provides those integrations.

use_cases.title: Prepare Brand Agreements
use_cases.description: Draft a creator agreement after the brand and influencer agree on campaign scope and payment.

use_cases.title: Review Agency Terms
use_cases.description: Check incoming contract language for usage rights, exclusivity, payment timing, revisions, and disclosure obligations.

use_cases.title: Standardize Partnership Templates
use_cases.description: Build reusable contract language for repeated influencer campaigns while keeping optional clauses easy to adjust.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Simple Agreement
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with known deal terms.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a basic influencer agreement for [brand] and [creator]. Deliverables are [items], payment is [amount], platforms are [platforms], and dates are [timeline].

prompt_templates.title: Review Incoming Terms
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of pasted contract text.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this agency contract for red flags. Focus on payment, usage rights, exclusivity, approvals, termination, FTC disclosures, and creator obligations: [paste terms].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Negotiation Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced preparation for unresolved deal terms.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a negotiation brief for these open terms: [terms]. Show acceptable ranges, fallback positions, risk notes, and clauses needing legal review.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Reusable Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced template design for recurring campaigns.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reusable influencer partnership template for [brand/category]. Include optional clauses for whitelisting, affiliate commissions, exclusivity, morality, confidentiality, and disputes.

output_examples.input: Draft a simple agreement for two Instagram posts, $500 payment, and one month of usage rights.
output_examples.output: Produces a short agreement covering scope, payment schedule, non-exclusive owned-channel usage, FTC disclosure, timeline, termination, and signature blocks.

output_examples.input: Review an agency contract that asks for perpetual usage rights and unlimited revisions.
output_examples.output: Returns a red-flag checklist, explains why the clauses are risky, and suggests narrower terms with paid extensions.

output_examples.input: Create negotiation notes for whitelisting, exclusivity, and net 60 payment terms.
output_examples.output: Provides standard ranges, compromise positions, business risks, and items that should go to legal counsel.

best_practices: Confirm all deal facts before drafting the final agreement.
Limit usage rights, whitelisting, and exclusivity by channel, territory, and time.
Send significant agreements to legal counsel before signing.
anti_patterns: Using the template as legal advice without review.
Leaving compensation, revision limits, or approval deadlines undefined.
Accepting perpetual usage rights or broad exclusivity without extra compensation.

faq.question: Can this skill draft a full influencer agreement?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft a structured agreement with scope, payment, usage rights, exclusivity, approvals, compliance, and signatures.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides templates and review guidance. A qualified attorney should review important contracts before signing.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide parties, deliverables, compensation, timeline, platforms, usage rights, exclusivity needs, approval process, and any pasted terms.

faq.question: Can it review an agency contract?
faq.answer: Yes. Paste the terms and ask for a review of missing essentials, red flags, and negotiation points.

faq.question: Does it cover FTC disclosures?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes disclosure reminders for sponsored content and platform branded content tools where available.

faq.question: Does it require external services?
faq.answer: No. The skill works from user-provided details. Optional CRM or e-signature connections depend on the host environment.
